[[File:Matawo coral.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Matawo coral]]
'''Matawo coral''' was a species of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It was named after the children of the [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] who discovered the species. Matawo coral grew only in the vicinity of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]. During the peak of its two-year spawn cycle, the coral glowed blue like kolto.<ref name="TOR:VCED">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Visitor's Center Exploration Dome|Manaan}}</ref>
